notes.title: NEW GAME IS OUT!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I'm excited to announce that my new game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3418910/Ginger/]ginger[/url], is out!

Thank you so much for your support and love over the past year. Some of you have already become my friends and our journey continues.

A lot happened last year, and I finally made a more abstract game. I hope you can pluck the unspeakable thing from it and find it as touching as I do.

Keep busy,
Kevin

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3418910/Ginger/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786702/981a54ce7c7c10278bdf9408504cbcef792e0c7d.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Happy 1st Anniversary!
notes.notes:
It was so fast. After graduating in 2022, I worked on this game full-time. I didn't think the game could let me make so many friends, give me confidence and truly confirm who I am.

I'm so grateful for the trust and support of my family, friends, and former strangers. You made my dream come true.

The journey has just started. I added some friends' language in this anniversary edition and I'll continue doing this every year. Making friends, as the game said, is a lifelong thing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786702/d0d97175e02ef7858bd46449b6e790cf27c3311c.jpg[/img]


The other part of the journey is also going on. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3418910/Ginger/]Ginger[/url] is coming!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786702/981a54ce7c7c10278bdf9408504cbcef792e0c7d.png[/img]

notes.title: Kevin(1997-2077) nominated for the IGF Nuovo Award!
notes.notes:
I'm so grateful my game, Kevin(1997-2077), [url=https://igf.com/finalists-and-winners]has been nominated for the Nuovo Award at the 2024 Independent Games Festival.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786702/77bba1dbdcf2b563f697ef072319e8be45b238e2.png[/img]

Thanks to all of you!! Without you, I wouldn't have made this game.

Also there are many awesome games in this year's IGF, please [url=https://igf.com/finalists-and-winners]check them out[/url] and wishlist if you like!

Cheers,
Kevin
